palette_rationale: Preserve reviewed pale face/dark eye edge, source eye tones where native pixels survive, purple skin, red gloves/scarf and white claws/tail tip from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr081 model and native clips; PMDO engine registry provides names, indices, events and timing fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded Idle and row-47 shadow. Walk foot contact per frame; retain native one-shot lift and localized below-shadow audit elsewhere.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own biped gait with alternating feet and tail; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native early leap and forward claw contact near 0.52s, then source recovery; never ground-trim Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native hand-to-mouth preparation and hands-out release; no projectile/effect invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouched rest with lowered head; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own startled backward recoil and raised gloves.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native arm/tail sweep and later outward stance, without a synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the native early leap/contact, one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own leap and landing arc sampled around the early source apex; no artificial height offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native preparation/strain and reverse-sampled recovery; no glow.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own pose motion with whole-view yaw; no duplicate endpoint.
